title: Paramount+ Reveals Its December 2026 Streaming Lineup
excerpt:
A new Garfield animated series is set for December 11.
SpongeBob, Ghosts and several returning shows also feature in the lineup.
body_md:
Paramount+ has outlined a selection of movies, series and seasonal specials arriving during December 2026. The month combines animated programming, returning television seasons, recognizable catalog films and holiday entertainment.

A new Garfield animated series is listed for December 11. The announced additions also include SpongeBob SquarePants Season 16 and the first two seasons of CoComelon's The Melon Patch, giving families several animation options during the holiday period.

Scripted television highlights include Tyler Perry's Ruthless Season 6 Part 2, All the Queen's Men Season 5 Part 2 and a Christmas special from Ghosts Season 6. The Beverly Hills Cop films are also expected to join the service's movie selection.

The schedule features further holiday and New Year's programming, but the feed does not provide a precise release day for every title. The December 11 date applies specifically to Garfield and should not be presented as a universal launch date for the entire lineup.
